reasoning_content: My sed mangled the COPY lines too. Let me rewrite the Dockerfile cleanly.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/addon_api/api/Dockerfile <<'EOF'
# Stage 2: build stage
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /wheels

COPY ./api/pyproject.toml .
COPY ./api/demospipes_addon_bmds_api/ ./demospipes_addon_bmds_api/
COPY ./data-structures/ ./shared-data-structures/
COPY ./data_structures/ ./addon-data-structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ ./shared-data-structures/ && \
    pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ ./addon-data-structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --find-links /tmp/local-wheels/ \
    --wheel-dir /wheels .

# Stage 3: final stage
FROM demospipes-base-api:v1.18.127-main-ce4cc11 AS final

WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

ENV HOME=/home/user
ENV PREFECT_HOME=$HOME/.prefect

RUN useradd user -u 1001 -g 0 -m && \
    mkdir -p "$PREFECT_HOME" && chown -R user "$PREFECT_HOME"

USER user

WORKDIR /app

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uvicorn", "demospipes_api.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
EOF
cd /tmp/addon_api && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 nohup docker build -t demospipes-addon-bmds-api:latest -f api/Dockerfile . > /tmp/build_addon_api.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 90; tail -18 /tmp/build_addon_api.log
